exposure: Clinical isolates of Candida species (C. albicans, C. glabrata, Candida parapsilosis)
cohort: Amniotic fluid samples were obtained from 23 pregnant women with gestational age of 38-41 weeks during cesarean section.
finding: Amniotic fluid collected from pregnant women had consistent and significant inhibitory activity against all Candida isolates tested, with complete inhibition of growth observed only against Candida glabrata.
